translation:
Dizziness with a corpulent body, palpitations and a moving pulse — this is the incipient stage of a stroke-like (類中) condition; one must rest and nourish and regulate the treatment.

Shudi (prepared Rehmannia, 熟地) 4 qian, Fushen (Poria with host wood, 茯神) 2 qian, Ganjü (chrysanthemum, 甘菊) 1.5 qian, Xixiancao (Siegesbeckia, 豨薟草) 1.5 qian, Shijueming (abalone shell, 石決明) 4 qian, old mulberry leaf (老桑葉) 1.5 qian, Guishen (Angelica root, 歸身) 2 qian, Zaoren (Ziziphus seed, 棗仁) 3 qian, Maidong (Ophiopogon, 麥冬) 2 qian, Baijili (Tribulus, 白蒺藜) 4 qian, Baizishuang (Biota seed frost, 柏子霜) 1.5 qian.

Yang does not join with yin, the nose is blocked and not clear, both knees are numb and not warm — this is because the fire of the Mingmen (命門) is faint. Use a method of subduing yang and warming and supplementing.

Shudi (prepared Rehmannia) 4 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Qizi (Lycium fruit, 杞子) 2 qian, Banxia (Pinellia, 半夏) 1.5 qian, Hutao rou (walnut kernel, 胡桃肉) 2 qian, Guishen 2 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Congrong (Cistanche, 蓯蓉) 1.5 qian, Xinhui pi (tangerine peel, 新會皮) 1 qian.

Little sleep and dizziness — yang does not join with yin; the six pulses are tight and rapid; without doubt liver fire with phlegm is the cause of the illness; guard against a stroke-like (類中) condition.

Shu Shouwu (prepared Polygonum multiflorum, 熟首烏), Fa Banxia (processed Pinellia, 法半夏), Fushen, Shijueming, Juhong (tangerine peel, 橘紅), Lingyangjiao (antelope horn, 羚羊角), Maidong rou (Ophiopogon flesh, 麥冬肉), Zaoren, Baijili, Chuan Yujin (Curcuma, 川鬱金).

Pill formula: remove Lingyang (antelope horn), Jili (Tribulus), and Yujin (Curcuma); add Yuzhu (Atractylodes, 於朮), Danxing (Arisaema with bile, 膽星), Shichangpu (Acorus, 石菖蒲), Huai Niuxi (Achyranthes, 淮牛膝), fresh Zhuru (bamboo shavings, 鮮竹茹), and Gougou (uncaria, 鉤鉤); make pills by spreading the decoction over the powder.

Sudden faintness and dizziness, distension and pain in the diaphragm region, the six pulses wiry and rapid — one should use the method of assisting metal (佐金法).

Chuan Huanglian (Coptis, 川黃連), Guishen, Fushen, Chuan Lianzi (Melia fruit, 川楝子), Muxiang (Saussurea, 木香), Zhuru (bamboo shavings), Dan Wuyu (Evodia, 淡吳萸), Baishao (white peony, 白芍), Zaoren, Shijueming, Juye (tangerine leaf, 橘葉).

Yang is originally deficient and the Jueyin (厥陰) qi is depressed, so that with exertion of body and mind there is dizziness and numbness of the limbs, and the pulse comes wiry and slippery. This is the mechanism of a stroke-like (類中) condition; regulate the treatment in advance.

Zhen Xidang (genuine Codonopsis, 真西黨), Shijueming, Fushen, Cao Yujin (Curcuma, 草鬱金), Juhong, Shu Shouwu, Baijili, Zaoren, Huai Niuxi, Zhuru.

The nutritive yin is internally damaged, blood does not nourish the liver, so that there is aversion to cold and a soft pulse, distension and pain in the diaphragm, and in addition the root of the tongue is not smooth and speech is unclear. One must relax the mind and nourish and rest, and this illness may be avoided.

Zi Danshen (red Salvia, 紫丹參) 3 qian, Fa Banxia 1.5 qian, Fushen 2 qian, stir-fried Baishao 1.5 qian, Chuan Yujin 1 qian, Da Shengdi (large raw Rehmannia, 大生地) 4 qian, roasted Muxiang 4 fen, Zaoren 3 qian, Dan Congrong (Cistanche, 淡蓯蓉) 1.5 qian, Juye 3 leaves.

The lung and stomach are not clear, and one cannot speak; this is damp phlegm congealing in the lung and stomach, the clear orifices being obstructed. Draft a formula for temporary use.

Stir-fried Baizhu (Atractylodes, 炒白朮) 2 qian, Fa Banxia 1.5 qian, Maidong 2 qian, Guishen 1.5 qian, Dan Ganjiang (dried ginger, 淡乾薑) 7 fen, stir-fried Maozhu (Atractylodes, 炒毛術) 1.5 qian, Xinhui pi 1 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Baijili 4 qian.

The voice is not clear and one cannot speak; this belongs to deficiency of qi in the lower burner; only warming and supplementing is appropriate.

Chuan Guizhi (cinnamon twig, 川桂枝), Fa Banxia, Fushen, Chuan Bei (Fritillaria, 川貝), Baijiezi (white mustard seed, 白芥子), ginger juice (薑汁), Zhi Yuanzhi (processed Polygala, 制遠志), Xinhui ren (tangerine seed, 新會仁), Zaoren, Qizi, Shichangpu.

Another pill formula:

Dangshen (Codonopsis, 黨參) 2 liang, Shudi 3 liang, Xiaqu (medicated leaven, 夏曲) 1 liang, Fushen 1.5 liang, Congrong 1 liang, Jubai (tangerine pith, 橘白) 7 qian, Yuzhu 2 liang, Changpu (Acorus, 菖蒲) 1 liang, Wuwei (Schisandra, 五味) 5 qian, Danxing 5 qian, Zaoren 2 liang, Rougui (cinnamon bark, 肉桂) 4 qian.

Make pills with light honey water.

Liver fire with phlegm, sudden faintness and dizziness; at this time of the season of growth, treat by dispersing wind and clearing and settling.

Lingyangjiao, Fa Banxia, Baijili, Hei Shanzhi (gardenia, 黑山梔), Shijueming, Shu Shouwu, Juhong, Tianma (Gastrodia, 天麻), Huai Niuxi, Shichangpu.

Middle deficiency with the liver region affected, heartburn and distension of the diaphragm; one must open the mind and nourish and rest, otherwise guard against a stroke-like (類中) condition.

Xi Dangshen (Codonopsis), Guishen, Fushen, Fa Banxia, Tianma, Zhi Yuzhu (processed Atractylodes, 制於術), Baishao, Zaoren, roasted Muxiang, Juye.

Then take Guipi Wan (歸脾丸, Spleen-Restoring Pill).

Numbness of the hands and feet, red patches on the face — a wind condition is about to form; harmonize the nutritive (營) and dispel wind, treating both.

Da Shudi (large prepared Rehmannia), Guishen, Qing Fangfeng (Saposhnikovia, 青防風), Honghua (safflower, 紅花), Hou Duzhong (Eucommia, 厚杜仲), Zhi Yuzhu, Chuanduan (Dipsacus, 川斷), Lujiaoshuang (deer antler frost, 鹿角霜), Mu Fangji (Stephania, 木防己), Guizhi (cinnamon twig).

Make pills with refined honey.

Wind-damp attacks the nutritive and defensive (營衛), so that there is numbness of the hands and feet and the skin and flesh are insensitive; treat by dispelling damp and nourishing the nutritive (營).

Zhen Maozhu (genuine Atractylodes, 真茅朮), Shu Shouwu, Chuanduan, Baijili, Qinjiao (Gentiana macrophylla, 秦艽), Chuan Niuxi (Achyranthes, 川牛膝), Zhi Yuzhu, stir-fried Guishen, Mugua (Chaenomeles, 木瓜), Xixiancao, Qizi, sheng Miren (raw Coix seed, 生米仁).

Boil deer antler glue (鹿角膠) 3 liang and make into pills.

The upper hands and feet are swollen, painful and insensitive, and speech is difficult; this is wind entering the collateral vessels (絡脈) and phlegm obscuring the clear orifices. One should treat by dispelling wind and removing phlegm.

Lingyangjiao, Qinjiao, Ci Jili (Tribulus, 刺蒺藜), Guishen, Fangfeng, Fa Banxia, Mugua, Wujiapi (Acanthopanax, 五加皮), Juhong, Rendongteng (honeysuckle stem, 忍冬藤).

Accumulated overwork with internal deficiency, lumbar pain and weakness of the limbs, exhaustion of the fluids, and moreover the six pulses are deep and weak with little strength. One must warm and supplement; otherwise guard against a stroke-like (類中) condition.

Dangshen, Shudi, Fushen, Qizi, Bei Wuwei (northern Schisandra, 北五味), Maidong, Guishen, Zaoren, Congrong, Hutao rou.

Yang faint and trapped by damp, the lumbar region and knees without strength — this is the foundation of a flaccid (軟中) condition; abstain from wine and be cautious.

Zhi Yuzhu, Guishen, Gouji (Cibotium, 狗脊), Chuan Fuzi (aconite, 川附子), Hutao (walnut), Da Shudi, Duzhong, Qizi, Wujiapi.
translator_notes: 類中 (lei zhong) rendered as 'stroke-like' to preserve the classical sense of a condition resembling wind-stroke without equating it to a modern diagnosis.
佐金法 (zuo jin fa) rendered literally as 'assisting metal method'.

translation:
The constitution is weak and fire flares, with tinnitus and dizziness and the diaphragm region not comfortable. First use a method of soothing the liver and clearing, then supplement to obtain effect.

Zhi Shouwu (processed Polygonum multiflorum, 制首烏), Qinghao (Artemisia annua, 青蒿), Shijueming, Huafen (Trichosanthes root, 花粉), Zexie (Alisma, 澤瀉), Yuan Shengdi (raw Rehmannia, 元生地), Ganjü, old mulberry leaf, Gougou (uncaria), sheng Gancao (raw licorice, 生甘草).

Tinnitus and dizziness, the six pulses wiry and slippery and not soft — liver fire with phlegm is the cause of the illness; first clear, then supplement.

Zhi Shouwu, Hei Shanzhi, Shijueming, Chiju (chrysanthemum, 池菊), Baijili, Fa Banxia, Fuling (Poria, 茯苓), old mulberry leaf, Huai Niuxi.

Sudden faintness and dizziness, distension and pain in the diaphragm region, the six pulses wiry and rapid — one should use the Zuojin method (左金法) (the formula is in the 類中 section).

Chuan Huanglian, Fushen, stir-fried Baishao, Muxiang, Chuan Lianzi, Zhuru, Dan Wuyu, Zaoren, Shijueming, Guishen, Zhen Juye (genuine tangerine leaf).

Liver wind with phlegm, guarding against epilepsy and faintness; the six pulses wiry and rapid; temporarily use a method of soothing the liver and eliminating fluid (when the four limbs are numb there is drowsiness and heaviness).

Zhi Shouwu, Fushen, Baijili, Shijueming, Gougou, Fa Banxia, Yujin, Xiangfu (Cyperus, 香附), Hei Shanzhi.

Liver wind with phlegm, numbness of the whole body, and in addition fright and palpitations with restlessness, repeatedly wanting to vomit and retch — this is the liver evil insulting the stomach, the middle qi being deficient. One should treat both the root and the branch (when lying down one does not sleep, when walking one cannot, when sitting the feet swell, and when lying down the swelling recedes; the condition belongs to damp phlegm, not beriberi).

Yuzhu, Fa Banxia, Baijili, Wujiapi, Fushen, Shidagonglao (Mahonia, 十大功勞), Maozhu, Bai Guishen (white Angelica root), Qinjiao, Shijueming, Zaoren.

Liver wind with phlegm, the clear empty orifices of the upper burner being obstructed. Treat by clearing and settling, soothing the liver and lowering qi (when the person is strong he has faintness and dizziness and falls down).

Lingyangjian (antelope horn tip, 羚羊尖), Fa Banxia, Hei Shanzhi, Fushen, Juhong, Chen Danxing (aged Arisaema with bile, 陳膽星), Zhi Shouwu, Shijueming, Baijili, Zaoren, Jiangxiang (Dalbergia, 降香).

Sore throat with cough and phlegm, distension of the diaphragm and loose stools — this is middle deficiency with the Jueyin (厥陰) transforming into wind; treat by regulating the middle and moistening the lung.

Sangbaipi (mulberry root bark, 桑白皮), Juhong, stir-fried Suzi (perilla seed, 炒蘇子), Jiegeng (Platycodon, 桔梗), Boheye (mint leaf, 薄荷葉), sheng Qi (raw Astragalus, 生耆), Gougou, Dalizi (Arctium, 大力子), Chiling (red Poria, 赤苓), Dongguazi (wax gourd seed, 冬瓜子).

Follow-up consultation:

Stir-fried Suzi, stir-fried Biandou (hyacinth bean, 炒扁豆), Juhong, Jiegeng, sheng Gancao, Chuan Shihu (Dendrobium, 川石斛), sheng Miren, Fuling, Yujin.

Distension of the diaphragm and dim vision, numbness of the root of the tongue and the fingers — at this time when the Jueyin (厥陰) is in charge, one does not dare to supplement hastily. I propose a method of dispersing wind and eliminating fluid, to observe the movement and stillness.

Baizheng Yuzhu (steamed Atractylodes, 百蒸於朮), Jili, Fushen, Guishen, Shijueming, ginger-processed Banxia, Ganjü, Zaoren, Xinhui (tangerine peel), winter mulberry leaf (冬桑葉).

After an epidemic illness, fright and fear, so that the lower part has seminal emission, rushing upward with vomiting and retching, stirring the liver wind, distension of the diaphragm and edema, and in addition the right pulse is slippery and large. First one should regulate the stomach and soothe the liver, then supplement the excess.

Ginger-processed Banxia, Guang Huo (patchouli, 廣藿), Daizheshi (hematite, 代赭石), Gougou, Zhuru, Chi Fushen (red Poria with host wood, 赤茯神), Hei Shanzhi, Baijili, Juhong.

Liver depression generating wind, internal heat and distension of the diaphragm, no thought of eating or drinking — use the method of treating by promoting movement (以通為補).

Yuanmi stir-fried Chuanlian (Coptis stir-fried with glutinous rice, 元米炒川連), Guang Huo, Xinhui, Da Mai ren (barley, 大麥仁), stir-fried Baishao, Fa Banxia, Yujin, Juye, Guixu (Angelica tail, 歸鬚), Hedai (lotus receptacle, 荷蒂).

Wood depression generating wind, palpitations and dry mouth, and in addition borborygmus insulting the earth (spleen), unable to transport fluids and nourish the flesh — one fears it may become a single abdominal distension (單腹); do not take it lightly.

Chuanlian, Fa Banxia, stir-fried Baishao, Zexie, Juye, Guang Huo, Bai Fuling (white Poria), Jiao Shenqu (stir-fried medicated leaven, 焦神麯), Hei Shanzhi.

Follow-up formula:

Earth-stir-fried Yuzhu, Fa Banxia, Fushen, Baishao, Hei Shanzhi, Chuan Shihu, Bai Guishen, Zaoren, Juye, Zexie.

The liver loses its nourishment, internal wind fans and blazes, at times the body and mind are agitated, the movement of qi and breathing is not smooth, so that there is phlegm and wheezing. Now examining the pulse, it is not fine and soft, and the spleen and stomach are not at fault — it is not necessarily that yang is originally deficient. Here use the Ganlu Yin (甘露飲) with additions and subtractions (the person is seventy years old, and it occurs every time at the hai hour (亥時); phlegm obstructs and qi rebels, blood is scanty and the liver is hyperactive).

Zhen Xidang, Shudi, Dan Tiantong (Ophiopogon, 淡天冬), Fushen, Baizishuang, Yuan Shengdi, Niuxi, Da Maidong (large Ophiopogon, 大麥冬), Zaoren, Yujin zhi (Curcuma juice, 鬱金汁).

Pill formula:

Xi Dangshen, Banxiaqu (Pinellia leaven, 半夏曲), Fushen, Baizishuang, Shijueming, Pipaye (loquat leaf, 枇杷葉), Da Shudi, Chenxiang mo (agarwood powder, 沉香末), Zaoren, Hutao shuang (walnut frost, 胡桃霜), Huai Niuxi.

Blood deficiency with liver depression, the Jueyin (厥陰) transforming into wind; the illness has lasted three years; use a method of softening the liver and cultivating the root, and take it continuously to obtain effect.

Shudi, Zhi Shouwu, Fushen, Qizi, Ganjuhua (chrysanthemum flower), Guishen, Shijueming, Zaoren, Niuxi, old mulberry leaf.

Follow-up formula:

Zhi Huangqi (honey-fried Astragalus, 炙黃耆), Ejiao (ass-hide glue, 阿膠), Fushen, Gan Qizi, Shijueming, Da Shudi, Guishen, Zaoren, Baizishuang, old mulberry leaf.

Liver fire with phlegm, sudden faintness and dizziness; at this time of the season of growth, one should treat by dispersing wind and clearing and settling.

Lingyangjiao, Fa Banxia, Shijueming, Baijili, Juhong, Shu Shouwu, Tianma, Hei Shanzhi, Huai Niuxi, Changpu.

The qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) is in excess, with fever at irregular times; when the heat is severe it generates wind, with clouding of the spirit and reversal and faintness; at this time of the ascending season, one should use a method of clearing the heart and soothing and settling (the menses do not come).

Zhi Shouwu, Maidong, Guixu, Shijueming, Zhishi (immature bitter orange, 枳實), Banxiaqu, Fushen, Hei Shanzhi, Chuan Yujin, Yimu gao (Leonurus paste, 益母膏) 2 qian, taken with water.

The nutritive fluid and yin are both deficient, the heart yang flies upward, the upper is excess and the lower is deficiency, easily hungry and timid; prolonged without recovery, the spirit and thought are weary, the pulse rapid and without strength. I propose a method of sweet and warm subduing and absorbing. Attach a formula for consideration.

Zhi Huangqi 2 qian, Maidong 3 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Qizi 3 qian, Xinhui hong (tangerine peel, 新會紅) 1 qian, Da Shudi 5 qian, Wuwei 4 fen, Zaoren 3 qian, Muli (oyster shell, 牡蠣) 4 qian, calcined, Longyan rou (longan flesh, 龍眼肉) 2 qian.

Heat depression of the liver and gallbladder generating wind, pain throughout the body, damp evil of the Yangming (陽明) descending, so that there is thirst that is not relieved, the left pulse tight and large. First use a method of dispersing wind and separating and regulating, then supplement to obtain effect.

Lingjiao pian (antelope horn slices, 羚角片), Guishen, Baijili, Chiling, sheng Miren, sheng Baizhu, Qinjiao, Chuan Xuduan (Dipsacus, 川續斷), Bixie (Dioscorea hypoglauca, 萆薢), Rendongteng.

Follow-up formula:

Zhi Shouwu, Baizhu, calcined Muli, Shayuan (Astragalus complanatus, 沙苑), fine Sangzhi (mulberry twig, 細桑枝), Guishen, Chuanduan, sheng Miren, Chi Shen (red Poria, 赤神), sheng Gancao.

The spirit and consciousness are not clear, with frequent faintness and dizziness — the empty orifices of the upper burner are obscured and closed. Treat by draining the heart and lowering qi.

Chuan Huanglian, Fa Banxia, Daizheshi, Zhishi, Zhuru, Fenghua xiao (sodium sulfate, 風化硝), stir-fried Suzi, Bai Fuling, Niuxi, Changpu.

The qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) is depressed; prolonged depression generates wind; severe wind generates phlegm; the clear orifices of the middle burner are obstructed. One must abstain from meat and wine, so as not to become clouded and deranged.

Lingyangjiao, Shijueming, Fa Banxia, Fushen, Jiangcan (silkworm, 殭蠶), Ganjuhua, Ming Tianma (Gastrodia, 明天麻), Tinglizi (Lepidium seed, 葶藶子), Hei Shanzhi, Zhuru.

The Jueyin (厥陰) transforms into wind, phlegm and qi obstruct the upper burner, so that the right pulse is slippery and rapid and the boils and nodules do not resolve; use a method of harmonizing the liver and transforming phlegm.

Zhi Yangshen (processed American ginseng, 制洋參), Xiangbei (Fritillaria, 象貝), Qinjiao, Shijueming, winter mulberry leaf, Xiakucao (Prunella, 夏枯草), Maidong, Juhong, Baijili, Hei Shanzhi.

Long suffering from dysentery (休息), and in addition hemoptysis; both conditions are cured, only that internal wind fans and stirs, so that there are palpitations and dizziness, the right pulse wiry and rapid. One should use Hei Guipi (黑歸脾) to supplement and free, and it will gradually settle and recover.

Zhi Yuzhu, roasted Muxiang, Fushen, stir-fried Baishao, Zhi Gancao (honey-fried licorice, 炙甘草), stir-fried Ejiao, Yuanzhi rou (Polygala flesh, 遠志肉), Zaoren, stir-fried Danpi (moutan bark, 炒丹皮).

The qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) is depressed, and prolonged it transforms into wind; the nutritive yin is secretly consumed, with insomnia, fire moving up to the upper burner, and pain and flaccidity of the vessels and sinews. At this time of the season of growth, one should disperse wind and rest and nourish.

Shudi, Guishen, Fushen, Qizi, Baiziren (Biota seed, 柏子仁), Yangshen, Maidong, Zaoren, Guiban (tortoise plastron, 龜板), Shidagonglao.

The Jueyin (厥陰) transforms into wind, the spirit does not keep to its abode, with repeated sweating, fire rising, palpitations and insomnia; treat by settling the po (魄) and bitter draining.

Chuanlian, Guishen, Fushen, Shijueming, Hei Shanzhi, Banxia, Maidong, Zaoren, Baijili, Juye.

Internal wind fans and blazes, the lung qi is not diffused, so that the nasal orifice is not clear and the face is red, swollen and twitching; clear the metal and transform wind, and the heat evil will drain of itself. This formula is for temporary use.

Lingyangjiao, Sangbaipi, Shijueming, Ganjü, Xixiancao, Jingjie (Schizonepeta, 荊芥), sheng Miren, Digupi (wolfberry root bark, 地骨皮), Zhimu (Anemarrhena, 知母), sheng Gancao.

Follow-up formula:

Shu Shouwu, Guishen, Sangye (mulberry leaf), Zexie, sheng Gancao, Maidong rou, Danpi, Xixian (Siegesbeckia), Hei Shanzhi.

The Yangming (陽明) is in excess and the Shaoyin (少陰) is insufficient; water does not nourish wood, liver fire moves internally, the pulse rapid and the limbs flaccid. One should treat by dispelling wind and cultivating water.

Shudi, Guishen, Niuxi, Qizi, sheng Hugu (tiger bone, 生虎骨), Shidagonglao, Shouwu, Qinjiao, Mugua, Chiling, Yuanwu ban (tortoise plastron, 元武板).

Much phlegm and dizziness, numbness of the four limbs, arising from spleen deficiency with damp, scanty blood and liver wind; the six pulses are slippery and large and not soft; treat by calming the liver and drying the earth (spleen).

Stir-fried Shudi, Yuzhu, Guishen, Baijili, Juhong, Fa Banxia, Maozhu, Baishao, Gan Qizi.

In ordinary times fond of drink, with overwork, fire moving and injuring the collaterals; according to what has been reported there was loss of blood, the liver lost its nourishment, the yin qi easily floats, and the Beginning of Spring (立春) is near. One should regulate from the heart, spleen and kidney.

Xi Dang (Codonopsis), Yuanzhi rou, Fushen, Miren, Hafen stir-fried Ejiao (clam-shell stir-fried ass-hide glue, 蛤粉炒阿膠), Maidong, Nüzhenzi (Ligustrum, 女珍子), Zaoren, Niuxi, Guiyuan rou (longan flesh, 桂圓肉).

Water does not nourish wood, liver wind blazes internally, the lung qi is attacked, the body and skin are not moist, the sinews and bones are not smooth — this is the beginning of a painful bi (痹) condition; cultivate water and soften the liver, treating both.

Zhi Shouwu 3 qian, Qinjiao 1.5 qian, Xixiancao 2 qian, Wujiapi 3 qian, Baizishuang 1.5 qian, Shidagonglao 2 qian, Jing Guishen 2 qian, Miren 4 qian, Difuzi (Kochia, 地膚子) 1.5 qian, winter mulberry leaf 1.5 qian, sheng Gancao 4 fen.

The lung and kidney are both deficient, with much phlegm and cough with qi rebelling, liver wind blazing internally, phlegm fire congealing and binding, swelling extending to the jaw and neck; temporarily use a method of eliminating phlegm and clearing, then supplement.

Sheng Mianqi (raw Astragalus, 生綿耆), Zhi Shouwu, Zhimu, Juhong, sheng Biejia (raw turtle shell, 生鱉甲), Zhen Chuanbei (genuine Fritillaria, 真川貝), Hake (clam shell, 蛤殼), Sangye.

The qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) is depressed, the collaterals injured and the channels defeated, the liver loses its nourishment, the wood wind becomes ever more severe, the pulse is not soft — use the method of treating by promoting movement (以通為補). I propose to use Hei Xiaoyao (黑逍遙) with a bitter draining method.

Yuanmi stir-fried Chuanlian 5 fen, Zhi Yuzhu 1.5 qian, stir-fried black Zaoren 3 qian, Zhi Xiangfu 3 qian, Shijueming 4 qian, calcined, stir-fried black Chaihu (Bupleurum, 炒黑柴胡) 8 fen, Bai Fushen 2 qian, stir-fried black Danpi 1.5 qian, Cao Yujin 1 qian, Juye 3 leaves.

Water deficiency with liver wind moving internally, so that the Xuli point (虛里) jumps; treat by joining the heart and kidney and harmonizing the liver.

Shu Shouwu 3 qian, Chuan Shihu 3 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Hei Shanzhi 1.5 qian, Muli 4 qian, calcined, Da Maidong 2 qian, stir-fried Baishao 1.5 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Xinhui 1 qian, Xianglian (lotus seed, 湘蓮) 7 grains.

At first the illness was cough and choking, then the uvula (帝丁) became distended and painful. This is the evil entering the Jueyin (厥陰) as the cause of the illness; treat by cultivating water and transforming wind.

Chen Ejiao (aged ass-hide glue, 陳阿膠), Dalizi, Renzhongbai (urine sediment, 人中白), Guixu, sheng Gancao, Huai Niuxi, Madouling (Aristolochia fruit, 馬兜鈴), Pipaye, Qingdai (indigo, 青黛), Xinjiang xie (new crimson silk, 新絳屑).
translator_notes: 亥時 (hai shi) is the double-hour 21:00–23:00; kept as 'hai hour' with the character.
虛里 (xuli) is the apical impulse region; rendered literally as 'Xuli point'.

translation:
Dizziness with a corpulent body, palpitations and a moving pulse — this is the incipient stage of a stroke-like (類中) condition; one must rest and nourish and regulate the treatment.

Shudi, Fushen, Maidong rou, Ganjü, Baijili, old mulberry leaf, Guishen, Zaoren, Shijueming, Xixian (Siegesbeckia), Baizishuang.

The constitution is weak and fire flares, with tinnitus and dizziness and the diaphragm region not comfortable. First use a method of soothing the liver and clearing, then supplement.

Yuan Shengdi, Qinghao, Shijueming, Huafen, Zexie, Zhi Shouwu, Ganjü, old mulberry leaf, Gouding (uncaria, 鉤丁), Gancao.

Tinnitus and dizziness, the six pulses wiry and slippery and not soft — liver fire with phlegm is the cause of the illness. First clear, then supplement.

Zhi Shouwu, Fa Banxia, Huai Niuxi, Baijili, Fuling, Shijueming, Ganjuhua, Hei Shanzhi, winter mulberry leaf.

Dizziness and distension of the diaphragm — the yin is deficient and the liver collaterals are not relaxed. Treat by regulating qi and dispersing wind together.

Guishen, Fushen, Ganjuhua, Chuan Yujin, Nüzhenzi, Juye, Baishao, Zaoren, Baijili, Zhi Xiangfu, Ejiao.

Dizziness with much phlegm, palpitations and little sleep — Kan and Li (坎離) do not join, and the heart and mind are not at peace. Use bitter draining to settle the spirit, and it will naturally be comfortable.

Chuanlian, Chensha-stirred Maidong (cinnabar-stirred Ophiopogon, 辰砂拌麥冬), Zaoren, Danshen, Juhong, Fa Banxia, Yun Fushen (Poria with host wood, 云茯神), Longchi (dragon tooth, 龍齒), Juye, Zhuru.
translator_notes: 坎離 (kan li) refers to the trigrams Water and Fire, i.e. the heart and kidney; rendered literally as 'Kan and Li'.
